# Arwen

> A shared, multi-currency budget and savings tracker. Free, no ads, no data-selling.

Arwen lets people track a household budget together. Invite people you trust into a
shared workspace as an Editor (full access) or a Viewer (read-only), log expenses and recurring
bills, and grow dedicated savings funds toward a goal. Balances display in whichever of 10
supported currencies each person actually uses. Sign-in is passwordless, a one-time code sent by
email, no password to manage.

## Status

Not yet publicly launched. The web app is in staging and the iOS and Android apps are still in
progress. Visitors can join a waitlist on the site to be notified when any of them are ready.

## Key facts

- Pricing: free, no paid tier
- Currencies supported: 10, including EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, CHF
- Sign-in: passwordless (one-time email code)
- Privacy: no ads, no data-selling, no third-party tracking
